title: Drawing Scenes in EGA like King's Quest
author: wunderbaba
selftext:
I’ve been shifting away from using more traditional GenAI models like BFL Flux and NB in favor of just giving LLMs access to a custom drawing language to generate imagery and its been going surprisingly well - (Opus 5.5, Qwen 3.8 27b, etc).

This creates Sierra AGI-style adventure game scenes painted live from *simple LOGO-esque drawing instructions* so you can basically provide it an empty canvas with positioned text labels where you want certain things (tavern, oak tree, etc) and it will generate a custom script for rendering them in a EGA graphics style.

I initially built it as a tool to help scaffold out backgrounds for an old-school point-and-click adventure game that I've been working on, but I decided to open-source it in the hopes that others can use it as well.

The coolest part is that you can use it for really silly things, like redrawing sets from old games. There are examples in the demo where I re-envision sets from games like King's Quest and Myst in an EGA style.



Live Site: [https://kq-styles.specr.net](https://kq-styles.specr.net/)

Github: [https://github.com/scpedicini/agi-stylist](https://github.com/scpedicini/agi-stylist)
